Principle: standards. Actions with a direct or indirect impact on the rights of indigenous peoples and local communities should only be pursued with their free, prior and informed consent, subject to national legislation and consistent with international instruments. When risks to indigenous peoples and local communities, women or youth cannot be fully avoided, an accessible, culturally appropriate grievance and redress mechanism should be established and maintained to enable affected rights holders to raise concerns and obtain remedy throughout the project cycle.
原則: 標準。對原住民族與地方社區權利具有直接或間接影響之行動，應僅在取得其自由、事先及知情同意之後，且在符合國家立法及與國際文書一致的情況下進行。 當無法完全避免對原住民族與地方社區、女性或青年之風險時，應建立並維持一個易於取得、符合文化適切性之申訴與補救機制，以使受影響之權利持有者能在整個計畫週期中提出疑慮並獲得補救。
